baseline.method: Independent original full acquisition and phase-contrast inverse, no measured velocity truth

reference_kind: independently reproduced original standard method; no actual velocity truth
tolerance_provenance: Frozen before cleaned implementation; original source block on Windows versus original complete Linux run has RMS7.91e-10m/s, DRNRMSE2.092e-9, max2.98e-8m/s. Same original arithmetic in float64 differs DRNRMSE2.071e-9. Nonzero1e-6 normalized bounds allow numerical backend precision without expanding a zero self-error. Physical phasor threshold accounts for complex64 angle/mean precision; no fitted phase or scale.
phase_phasor_rms_definition: sqrt(mean(abs(exp(i*(pi*v/VENC+mean_t theta))-exp(i*theta))^2)) on all3directions and the fixed public magnitude mask; theta=atan2(imag(Sd*conj(S0)),real(...)), independent complex128 arithmetic; VENC=.16m/s
outside_mask_max_definition: Maximum absolute submitted velocity over all3directions outside reference magnitude>0.10global maximum, in m/s
